es.summary: Antibiótico macrólido que inhibe fuertemente la enzima hepática CYP3A4, aumentando la concentración de fármacos metabolizados por ella.
key_points: Inhibe la actividad de CYP3A4, potenciando efectos y toxicidad de fármacos como estatinas y anticoagulantes.
Se usa para infecciones respiratorias, de piel y de transmisión sexual.
Puede causar hepatotoxicidad y prolongación del QT.
Interacciones importantes con medicamentos que dependen de CYP3A4 para su eliminación.

mechanism: Se une al sitio activo de CYP3A4 y bloquea su capacidad para metabolizar sustratos.
Reduce la oxidación de fármacos, prolongando su vida media plasmática.
indications: Infecciones de vías respiratorias superiores e inferiores causadas por bacterias sensibles.
Uretritis no gonocócica y cervicitis por Chlamydia trachomatis.
Profilaxis de infecciones en pacientes con VIH que reciben ritonavir.
contraindications: Hipersensibilidad conocida a eritromicina o a otros macrólidos.
Pacientes con arritmia prolongada del QT sin supervisión médica.
adverse_effects: Prolongación del intervalo QT, riesgo de torsades de pointes (serio).
interactions: Aumenta niveles de estatinas (simvastatina, lovastatina) → riesgo de rabdomiolisis.
Incrementa concentración de benzodiacepinas metabolizadas por CYP3A4 (midazolam).
nursing_care: Revisar lista de medicamentos antes de administrar eritromicina.
Obtener valores de LFT (AST, ALT) y ECG si el paciente tiene factores de riesgo QT.
Monitorear signos de toxicidad: ictericia, dolor abdominal, sangrado.
Retener la dosis si ALT >3× límite superior normal o si QT >450 ms.
Notificar al médico ante cualquier reacción alérgica o alteración hepática.
patient_teaching: Tomar el medicamento con alimentos para minimizar irritación gástrica.
No suspender sin consultar; completar el ciclo prescrito.
Informar al médico sobre todos los medicamentos, incluidos suplementos.
Reportar síntomas de ictericia, dolor abdominal intenso o palpitaciones.

related_to: uso concomitante de fármacos metabolizados por CYP3A4
outcomes: Mantener niveles terapéuticos de los fármacos concomitantes sin signos de toxicidad
Preservar función hepática normal (AST/ALT dentro de rango)

interventions.action: Revisar y actualizar la lista de medicamentos del paciente antes de iniciar eritromicina
interventions.rationale: Identificar posibles interacciones que puedan causar toxicidad.

interventions.action: Obtener y monitorear pruebas de función hepática (AST, ALT) al iniciar y durante el tratamiento
Evaluar signos de toxicidad (ictericia, dolor abdominal, sangrado, arritmia)
interventions.rationale: Permite intervención temprana ante efectos adversos graves.

interventions.action: Educar al paciente sobre la importancia de reportar cualquier síntoma nuevo o empeoramiento
interventions.rationale: Facilita la detección oportuna de reacciones adversas.

interventions.action: Comunicar al médico cualquier alteración de LFT o ECG para posible ajuste de dosis o cambio de terapia
interventions.rationale: Previene progresión de daño hepático o arritmias.

en.summary: Macrolide antibiotic that strongly inhibits the hepatic enzyme CYP3A4, increasing the concentration of drugs metabolized by it.
key_points: Inhibits CYP3A4 activity, potentiating effects and toxicity of drugs such as statins and anticoagulants.
Used for respiratory, skin, and sexually transmitted infections.
Can cause hepatotoxicity and QT prolongation.
Important interactions with medications that depend on CYP3A4 for elimination.

mechanism: Binds to the active site of CYP3A4 and blocks its ability to metabolize substrates.
Reduces drug oxidation, prolonging plasma half‑life.
indications: Upper and lower respiratory tract infections caused by susceptible bacteria.
Non‑gonococcal urethritis and cervicitis due to Chlamydia trachomatis.
Prophylaxis of infections in HIV patients receiving ritonavir.
contraindications: Known hypersensitivity to erythromycin or other macrolides.
Patients with prolonged QT arrhythmia without medical supervision.
adverse_effects: QT interval prolongation, risk of torsades de pointes (serious).
interactions: Increases levels of statins (simvastatin, lovastatin) → risk of rhabdomyolysis.
Increases concentration of benzodiazepines metabolized by CYP3A4 (midazolam).
nursing_care: Review medication list before administering erythromycin.
Obtain LFT (AST, ALT) and ECG if patient has QT risk factors.
Monitor for signs of toxicity: jaundice, abdominal pain, bleeding.
Hold dose if ALT >3× upper limit of normal or QT >450 ms.
Notify physician of any allergic reaction or hepatic alteration.
patient_teaching: Take medication with food to minimize gastric irritation.
Do not discontinue without consulting; complete prescribed course.
Inform physician of all medications, including supplements.
Report symptoms of jaundice, severe abdominal pain, or palpitations.

outcomes: Maintain therapeutic levels of concomitant drugs without signs of toxicity
Preserve normal hepatic function (AST/ALT within range)

interventions.action: Review and update patient medication list before starting erythromycin
interventions.rationale: Identify potential interactions that could cause toxicity.

interventions.action: Obtain and monitor liver function tests (AST, ALT) at initiation and during treatment
Assess signs of toxicity (jaundice, abdominal pain, bleeding, arrhythmia)
interventions.rationale: Allows early intervention for serious adverse effects.

interventions.action: Educate patient on importance of reporting any new or worsening symptoms
interventions.rationale: Facilitates timely detection of adverse reactions.

interventions.action: Communicate any LFT or ECG changes to physician for possible dose adjustment or therapy change
interventions.rationale: Prevents progression of hepatic damage or arrhythmias.

sections.interactions.0.quote: Simvastatin and lovastatin have a high likelihood of interacting with many other drugs.

sections.patient_teaching.3.quote: Report any symptoms of liver failure (rare) to their provider: yellowish skin or eyes, nausea, vomiting, upper right abdominal pain, general feeling of unwellness.
